newsitem.title: JAPAN: ODR management to remain important for economy - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: ODR management to remain important for economy - BOJ.

text.p: The importance for the Japanese economy of managing the official discount rate (ODR) will not change even after liberalisation of the country's financial markets, Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Thursday.

Matsushita was asked by a member of parliament whether the BOJ will have the freedom to raise the official discount rate (ODR) when it wants to after the financial markets are liberalised, as many think such decisions will be constrained by market interest rates.

"Although some think that the role of ODR management will change after financial liberalisation, the effect of announcements of BOJ policy decisions through ODR management is still great. Even if liberalisation is carried out, the importance of ODR management will not change," Matsushita said.

Concerning the current management of monetary policy, Matsushita said: "I believe it is important to deal with this flexibly, depending on economic and financial conditions, through a combination of ODR management and guiding market interest rates through our operations."
